title: At a White House summit, Xi Jinping says the US and China share the "capability and responsibility" to manage AI for good and calls for healthy competition (Peter Wells/Financial Times)
summary: Peter Wells / Financial Times: At a White House summit, Xi Jinping says the US and China share the “capability and responsibility” to manage AI for good and calls for healthy competition — Israeli leader's speech comes on high-profile day for international relations as Donald Trump hosts Xi Jinping at the White House
